body:
Checked to be clearer (and discussed with @bobylito), our [eslint rules](https://github.com/algolia/eslint-config-algolia) already enforces:
- spaces
- two spaces
- add a single empty line to files
- trim whitespace

And those will error and are checked but only for JavaScript files.

Thus this issue is mostly about having the same behavior for all other file types (md, html, txt), given that most editors have defaults, editorconfig solve that (install it on atom, it's by default on vs code, vim: you are a hacker, deal with it!)
